submission.justification: Mixture-G2 with a 2.0 mm gas gap achieves the best time resolution of 0.916 ns among all tested configurations. This is 43% better than Mixture-G3 (1.314 ns at 2.5 mm) and 121% better than Mixture-G1 (2.025 ns at 2.0 mm). The 2.0 mm gap represents the optimal point for Mixture-G2, with time resolution degrading at both smaller and larger gaps. All three candidate mixtures are available from suppliers, compatible with the HV system, and have gas recirculation systems planned. Since Mixture-G2 is listed as a valid candidate and no explicit policy documents prohibit fluorinated mixtures, it is the recommended choice to meet the primary goal of achieving the best possible time resolution.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible time resolution
requirements.evidence: Mixture-G2 at 2.0 mm achieves 0.916 ns time resolution, which is the best among all 15 simulated configurations (3 mixtures × 5 gap sizes)
